# Ship of Theseus - Code Visualizer

> An interactive codebase visualization tool built by Asif Sayyed that tracks how much of a project's original code survives over time.

## Quick Links
- [Author Portfolio](https://sayyedasif.com/)
- [Author Github](https://github.com/asifdotexe)
- [Project Philosophy](https://second-brain.asifdotexe.workers.dev/?stackedNotes=ship-of-theseus)
- [Project Blog](https://sayyedasif.com/blogs/ship-of-theseus-codebase-entropy/)

## Core Features
- **Visualizes Git History:** Maps line survival over time using a stacked area chart.
- **Milestones:** Highlights major version releases or events like the ChatGPT release.
- **Insights:** Calculates the percentage of foundation code remaining, birth year, oldest surviving code, peak survival year, and average code age.
